reviews.text: As usual a fabulous service and Ralph looks stunning .. smooth coat smells lovely and alway happy to see Kathryn

Pickle loves her grooming, and comes out looking a new dog!

(And it sure beats the hours and hours it would take me when I did it myself during the lockdowns .... and then it looked like she'd been attacked by a lawn mower).
Kathryn really takes time and care of Furlo he looks amazing when she’s worked her magic. Would definitely recommend, thanks Kathryn
great service and really looked after our two dogs R&R. thanks again

Kathryn is absolutely wonderful with my dog, Alf. She’s professional, friendly, and genuinely loves the animals she works with — it really shows! She always gives great advice and takes such care in her grooming. Alf not only looks and smells amazing after every visit, but he’s also completely at ease with her. And the fact that she comes to you just makes everything even easier. Highly recommend!
Kathryn is so good with our two dogs, one of which is very anxious. She takes time to listen and offers great tips too. We couldn’t be happier!
Amazing groom as always! Highly recommend! My dogs love it xx
Great service, very convenient with the groomer coming to you

Kathryn did a fantastic  job with Bear our 22 month old Rottweiler, he was silky, shiny and smelling lovely, and a very happy boy…. for the moment he’s not making another Rottweiler through all the coat shedding …..Thank you so much 👏👏 …
Kath is always great with my dogs. Although they can be anxious she is calm and always understanding. I’m always really pleased with their groom and would highly recommend All About Grooming.
Kathryn is great with our little pooch. Highly recommended.

We recently moved to the area, we were sad to say goodbye to our old groomer as she was brilliant but it was too far to travel. In Katherine we have found a perfect replacement, the dogs love her and she does an excellent cut. The added bonus is that she also comes to your house. Would highly recommend.

We had our first appointment today a full groom for our cocker spaniel. We are extremely pleased from the moment we met Kathryne who is a lovely person  she has done an excellent job would certainly  recommend
My first time of using Kathryn's services and I was really pleased. Will definitely keep using.
As always beautiful cut and care for Ruby. She always looks good 😊 …
